@{5f1a5a360ab2a046d22bc971|full_name}: what you mentioned is right but it will NEVER lag or crash the user 
to make this easier to understand let us see what are vrchat processes that mainly cause the lag when normally your friend join you (didn't analyze traffic this what my eyes analyzed)
1- adding number to users in the room 
2- receive that the user joining is your friend
3- loading name tag
4- loading blue man model first
5- receive information about friends avatar 
6- start downloading avatar 
7- after downloading switching blue man to friend's avatar 
8- loading meshes
9- applying textures 
10- applying shaders
11-get other things ready from the avatar like audio and animations
12- applying any rendering or shader that the world force
13- when you have performance preferences it applies which means it will switch avatar to grey man model
14- receive every move that your friend do
Compared to @{5f0c9475215371696d1b6923|full_name} idea :
1- receive avatar information 
2- download avatar
so yes this feature will NOT have anything to do with lagging or crashing as avatars will not appear until you meet your friends that is why it is perfect as it will reduce/split the processes running when you meet your friend in today vrchat so highly recommend adding this feature

details:
Hi everyone,
can you please vote to add advance options in settings to load friends' avatars when they are online in other worlds or even offline this will help make things a lot faster specially that now there is 5G and fiber internet and who knows how soon we will get to 6G talking about myself I have 1000 Mb/s ( about 120 MB/s) so no matter how much things loading will not slow my internet neither my Monster Pc (I have some friends on vrchat with faster internet)and I don't want vrchat to be less than real life in real life you don't wait for people to load neither vrchat will if this option is added
and to give the story behind this idea (please share a story happened to you that was going to be better with this idea)
I was in a very awkward position today as we ( 9 animators) did a challenge everyone made 3 different animation and tried to get as much reaction from people and record it then we all meet and make a showcase for animations to rate it and rate reactions too so I had some amazing models and animations but it looks like it was a little bit bigger than normal so I needed to wait about 5 min and even more with others to just show a single avatar .it took sooooo long to get some reactions :( . I kept thinking of it for the rest of the day until I got this idea so please add it it will help the platform so much.
Thank you
title: Load friends avatars even in different worlds
